name: stock-swarm
description: Multi-agent trading research skills: technical, fundamental, sentiment, news, debate, risk, and portfolio synthesis.

interface.shortDescription: Multi-agent trading research skills for stocks and portfolios.
interface.longDescription: Stock Swarm is a suite of Agent Skills that mirror a trading desk: analysts gather evidence, bull and bear debate, a trader proposes actions, risk analysts stress the plan, and a portfolio manager issues a five-tier rating. Optional skills cover macro regime, market scans, portfolio health, EODHD data, and US tax education. Research and education only — not financial advice.
